text:
zara: hey team, new hire here — trying to wire up secrets for `feature-flagger` across dev/stage/prod. who owns vault paths and how do i request a KMS key? :wave:
luca: welcome! file the infra secrets form (https://secrets.redwood.internal/new) with service name, envs, owner, and whether you need a new CMK. infra will create the Vault path and policies.
ops: quick tip: include the CI principal that needs decrypt access (e.g. circleci/flagger-runner) or we'll have to reopen the ticket. also state rotation preference (default 90d).
zara: who should be the owner? i'm on platform but product owns the feature flags.
luca: put yourself as initial owner if you'll review rotates and approvals. add product alias as co-owner in the form. owners get notif for access requests and rotation PRs.
infra-bot: :robot_face: Use `/secret-request` to prefill the form in Slack. It creates a ticket and posts it to #eng-infra for faster review.
zara: any SLAs on non-prod vs prod?
ops: non-prod usually done the same day (4-6 hrs). prod with a new CMK or compliance checks takes 1-2 business days. we'll publish the created path like `secret/data/services/feature-flagger/prod` in the ticket.
zara: emergency access at 3am — who do I call?
luca: call oncall then DM @eng-infra. there's an emergency checklist in docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/secrets/oncall. Make sure to add a post-hoc justification to the ticket.
zara: thanks all — i'll run `/secret-request` and paste the ticket here for review.
